items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Every Sunday, there was Baby Lovey. he was a drummer. He was in Kansas City now, with Lee's band. And we was all connected together... We had a big orchestra used to rehearse every Sunday... we'd invite all the musicians to that rehearsal

ctx.x: Yeah. He played by Bronk Johnson playing the trumpet. And Harry Walker in Alexander. Well, they had some different bands around there. You know, they all played the Red Book. We was all connected together, you see. We had a big orchestra used to rehearse every Sunday. We just rehearsed over to them. And we'd invite all the musicians to that rehearsal, you know, a bunch of men. Every Sunday, there was Baby Lovey. he was a drummer. He was in Kansas City now, with Lee's band.
